operative_clauses.original_operative_text: Section 1. Creation of Emergency Board. There is created, effective April 3, 1992, a board of five members to be appointed by the President to investigate this dispute. No member shall be pecuniarily or otherwise interested in any organization of railroad employees or any railroad carrier. The board shall perform its functions subject to the availability of funds.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 268889; common-crawl capture 2026-01-19T07:43:09Z; Sec. 1

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: Sec. 2. Report. The board shall report to the President on May 3, 1992, with respect to this dispute.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 268889; common-crawl capture 2026-01-19T07:43:09Z; Sec. 2

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: Sec. 3. Maintaining Conditions. As provided by section 10 of the Act, from the date of the creation of the board and for 30 days after the board has submitted its report to the President, no change in the conditions out of which the dispute arose shall be made by the railroads or the employees, except by agreement of these parties.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 268889; common-crawl capture 2026-01-19T07:43:09Z; Sec. 3

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: Sec. 4. Expiration. The board shall terminate upon the submission of the report provided for in section 2 of this order.
